A middle-aged woman with light skin and long, wavy white hair parted slightly off-center smiles at the camera. She wears light-framed eyeglasses, gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a small pendant. She is dressed in a light gray v-neck top under a light beige cardigan. Her lips are slightly parted, showing her upper teeth.

In front of her on a dark gray countertop are three round fruits: a red and yellow peach, a green lime, and a bright orange. To the right of the fruits is a teal bowl with a lighter green interior containing three light green apples.

Behind the woman is a kitchen setting. A white tiled backsplash covers the wall. Two light brown wooden shelves are mounted on the wall. The top shelf holds a small terracotta pot with a green plant, a silver cylindrical container, and a larger terracotta pot. The lower shelf holds a white bowl with a green plant and a larger white bowl. To the left, slightly out of focus, is a silver kettle on the countertop and a blurred window or doorway showing greenery. The lighting is soft and diffused, coming from the front.
